# ZayuAPI modules

Upstream management, operational dashboard and related components adapted from mizaawa/zayuapi v0.2.202, commit fd8c91e8554528c57be7f2eeb2cf7dfc40d94dcc (the version deployed at CS1). Original license retained in LICENSE. Kitty adaptations: transactional provider persistence and procurement bindings; existing financial data and usage costs; managed background refresh.
